name: Rabbit R1
desc: Pocket voice device that drives the phone for you
desc_zh: 能替手机操作的口袋语音设备
solves: Unlocking the phone to set a timer is most of the task. The r1 listens and works the app — screen off, phone still in your pocket.
solves_zh: 设个计时器，光解锁就占掉大半。r1 听懂后直接替你操作，屏幕关着、手机还在口袋里就行。
best_for: When your hands are busy and the task is one you would normally do on your phone.
best_for_zh: 当你的手正忙着，而这件事本来要在手机上做。
notes: 形态取 desktop：R1 是实体硬件设备，rabbitOS 为其预装客户端，本仓枚举无独立 device 值
